messages:
maria (devex): Hi — hitting a support case where the CLI quickstart (`ri-cli init`) returns `402 Payment Required` and then the CLI keeps retrying for ~5 minutes. User pasted logs, asking what should the UX be and if we should treat 402 as non-retryable.

josh (sdk): can you paste the exact log snippet? is it the HTTP response or our SDK wrapper retrying?

maria (devex): paste from user:
```
[2026-02-18T14:02:03Z] ri-cli: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 402 Payment Required
[2026-02-18T14:02:03Z] ri-cli: retrying request (1/10) after 1500ms
[2026-02-18T14:02:04Z] ri-cli: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 402 Payment Required
[2026-02-18T14:02:10Z] ri-cli: retrying request (2/10) after 2000ms
... (repeats for ~5min)
```
User says they had just finished signup, didn't see a billing prompt, and didn't get a workspace created.

etienne (eng): The 402 path should be non-retryable — if a tenant is blocked by billing/TOS we should surface that immediately. Looks like the Node CLI uses our generic retry middleware which treats 4xx as retriable for some codes (bug).

josh (sdk): Confirmed: Node SDK old retry config only treats 429/5xx as retryable, but a recent change accidentally added a blanket `if (!isNetworkErr)` check that let 402 fall through to the retry loop. Python client explicitly marks 402/401 as terminal.

maria (devex): From a DX perspective we should: 1) make CLI show an explicit message: "Workspace blocked — complete billing or contact billing@redwood.ai (error 402)" 2) not spam retries 3) include a quick link or CLI hint to open console (or run `ri account status`).

josh (sdk): I opened PR #4123 to make 402/401 non-retryable in the Node SDK and add a clearer CLI error message + exit code. Also added a small help snippet in the CLI when 402 is returned:
```
If you see 402: run `ri account status` or visit https://console.redwood.ai/organization/<org-id>/billing
To create a workspace: `ri workspace create --name quickstart`
```

maria (devex): Nice. For immediate triage, told the user to: 1) run `ri account status` and check `billing_state` 2) if `unpaid` or `missing_payment_method` go to billing console or add card via `/settings/billing` 3) if they think it's a signup bug, share the org id and I can escalate.

josh (sdk): Also logging a follow-up task to add an SDK parity test so Node/Python/Go treat 402 the same. Will add an integration test that simulates a 402 and asserts CLI exits without retries.

deploy-bot: Deployed ri-cli v0.9.3 to staging (includes 402 handling fix) — watch for smoke test results. :rocket:

etienne (eng): thanks — assigning myself to backport to the dedicated CLI branch.

maria (devex): marking this as a DX onboarding friction item. If anyone sees a pattern from support tickets, ping me and I'll compile a short KB article with exact troubleshooting steps. :memo:
